scripts.test: npm run test:js && npm run test:rust
scripts.test:js: npm run test:server && npm run test:web
scripts.test:server: cd services/identity-node && npx vitest run --config vitest.contracts.config.ts
scripts.test:web: vitest run && npm --prefix web-portal run test:mls && npm --prefix web-portal run test:freq
